persian.name: مهمان
persian.long_meaning: Mehman (مهمان) نامی برگرفته از زبان فارسی است و معنای اصلی آن مهمان، مهمان است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: मेहमान
hindi.long_meaning: Mehman (मेहमान) फ़ारसी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ मेहमान, अतिथि है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.long_meaning: Mehman (مېلمه) د فارسي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې مېلمه، مېلمه ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: مِهْمَان
arabic.long_meaning: Mehman (مِهْمَان) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة الفارسية، ومعناه الأساسي مِهْمَان، الضَّيْف. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Mehman can be understood through the Persian form مِهْمَان, whose central sense is mehman; guest (persian). Mehman is Persian مهمان (mehmān), meaning 'guest'. It is used as a male given name in Azerbaijan and Iran.

faq.a: Mehman is associated with the Persian form مِهْمَان, whose core sense is mehman; guest (persian).

faq.q: What is the origin of Mehman?
faq.a: Mehman is associated with Persian. Mehman is Persian مهمان (mehmān), meaning 'guest'. It is used as a male given name in Azerbaijan and Iran.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Mehman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mehman should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Mehmān is a Persian word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Mehman mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Mehman is rendered مہمان and carries the sense مہمان، مہمان.

faq.q: What does Mehman mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Mehman is rendered مهمان and carries the sense مهمان، مهمان.
A romanized syllable approximation is meh-man. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Mehman?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Mehman, mehman. Script forms are مهمان, مِهْمَان, مہمان, مېلمه, मेहमान.

faq.q: Is Mehman a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
